description: This file defines the IoTFleetHubClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS IoT Fleet Hub service. It includes method annotations for various API operations associated with the service, such as creating, deleting, describing, and listing applications and resources.

classes.name: IoTFleetHubClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS IoT Fleet Hub service, extending the generic AwsClient to provide specific API methods for the service.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes an existing IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: describeApplication
methods.description: Describes details of a specific IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: listApplications
methods.description: Lists all IoT Fleet Hub applications.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: updateApplication
methods.description: Updates an existing IoT Fleet Hub application.
